text:
Juventus come to this match without 11 first-team players, including Weston McKennie, Kenan Yildiz, Khephren Thuram and Manuel Locatelli.
Coach Luciano Spalletti has only 15 outfield players available, so he has limited options to rotate his squad, except in defence, where Lloyd Kelly and Federico Gatti will join Gleison Bremer.
According to Sky Sport and Gazzetta, Pierre Kalulu will start at right wing-back, while Koopmeiners will join Pape Matar Sarr in central midfield.
Koopmeiners will cross paths with his younger brother Peer, who is also a central midfielder and is expected to start for AZ.
Randal Kolo Muani and Nick Woltemade are likely to start up front, with Jeremie Boga completing a three-man attack, allowing Kerim Alajbegovic to rest.
AZ Alkmaar vs. Juventus – where to watch on TV
The match will be broadcast live on TNT Sports 4 and HBO Max in the UK and Ireland and on Paramount+, DAZN USA and ViX in the USA. Football Italia will provide live updates via a live blog.
AZ Alkmaar vs. Juventus – probable line-ups
AZ Alkmaar (4-2-3-1): De Busser; Dijkstra, Goes, Schouten, de Wit; P. Koopmeiners, Kwakman; Oufkir, Byskov, Daal; Meerdink.
